about:
MECA Electronics, Inc. was founded in 1961 in Denville, New Jersey. The privately held corporation operates under the name Microwave Equipment & Components of America and has manufactured RF and microwave components in the United States for over six decades.

The company designs and produces a broad line of passive RF and microwave components, including fixed attenuators, directional couplers, hybrid couplers, isolators, circulators, power dividers and combiners, RF loads, DC blocks, bias tees, cables, and adapters. Its portfolio extends to integrated assemblies and a high-reliability ML series qualified to military specifications such as MIL-DTL-23971, MIL-DTL-15370, MIL-DTL-39030E, and MIL-STD-202. Products cover frequencies up to 50 GHz and are built by J-STD certified assemblers with standard and enhanced screening options.

MECA serves public safety, rail and transportation, commercial wireless (including distributed antenna systems), 5G/6G and VSAT/SATCOM millimeter-wave markets, as well as aerospace, defense, and space programs. Rail products meet EN50155 environmental standards, while low-PIM components address commercial wireless infrastructure with no power derating to 85 °C. The company also provides value-added kitting and integration of customer-supplied parts.

MECA emphasizes rugged, U.S.-made construction backed by a 36-month warranty. Its differentiators include IP67/68-rated enclosures, thermal and electrical screening processes, and a focus on traceability for ground, air, and space communications where qualification requirements are stringent.
